changelog: 🤖 Gemini 3.8 Flash Multimodal AI Healthcare Assistant upgrade (/ai-chat)
📄 AI Medical Report Scanner: Extracts tests, measured values, units, printed reference ranges, and flags abnormal readings
⚠️ Optical & Handwriting Uncertainty Detection: Displays clear warning indicators for unclear handwriting or low-quality scans
💡 Plain-Language Medical Explanations: Translates complex clinical terminology, explains what tests measure, and clarifies reference range differences
🩺 Tailored Questions for Doctor: Generates practical, actionable questions for physician consultations with 1-click clipboard copy
💊 Multimodal Prescription Scanner: Extracts medicine names, dosages, frequencies, and durations while strictly refusing to invent unreadable drugs
➕ 1-Click Medicine Schedule Import: Direct sync from scanned prescriptions to the LifeGuard Medicine Tracker
📝 Doctor Consultation Summary Generator: Synthesizes diagnostic findings into an executive consultation brief with print/PDF support
🌐 6-Language Support: English, Tamil (தமிழ்), Hindi (हिंदी), Telugu (తెలుగు), Kannada (ಕನ್ನಡ), and Malayalam (മലയാളം) with native voice synthesis and speech recognition
🔒 Secure Backend Integration & Privacy: Server-side Gemini API endpoints, sliding-window rate limiting, document validation, and encrypted conversation history with markdown/json export
